notes:
What's new in 0.1.110:
- Away from home: a slow lookup of a .local network name from a connecting device no longer holds up the helper, which repairs a same-network connection timeout seen with the personal address. Automated tests and two source reviews only; not yet proven on a real second device.
- New: the browser sign-in page has a "Keep me signed in on this browser" box. It is off by default; left off, the sign-in ends when the browser closes. Ticked, the browser stays signed in until the normal sign-in length runs out (sign-in lengths are unchanged). Signing out, changing a password or "sign out everywhere" ends it.
- Users: unselected buttons are readable again in the light themes. Story Studio: a motion story keeps its title and its scene cards show a short label. Connections setup sites are real links. Home: an incomplete Wi-Fi hint is hidden instead of crashing Get Started.
- Library Health shows a start-up error and keeps a correct count beyond 200 findings. Trip links refresh when they expire. Converted Videos shows no larger/smaller comparison when a size is missing or equal. Create can no longer make two share codes.
- Photos and the Picture Frame: thumbnails come from a checked copy of the photo; the frame sends no photo once its screen is off by schedule and drops photos and retries still on their way when its list is replaced.
- Playback: choosing a quality while paused keeps the film paused; a second click on Original is no longer lost; automatically restored subtitles no longer rewrite your saved choice; Resume follows the newest real viewing session; late, older conversion requests are refused, even after a restart.
- Not yet checked: automated tests and code review only; not tried on a real second device or PC by a person. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not in this release.
- Release source commit 47ce44fe1.
- Built: Nov 1, 2026, 3:40 PM Eastern.
- Published: Nov 1, 2026, 3:42 PM Eastern.
